scope: Connect reviewed-consent diagnostics and recoverable owner history; verify actual assignment-to-five-stage API path.
riskAnalysis: Owner readback adds metadata only. UI shares one action list for diagnostics, retains finite safe codes, and cannot grant authority through history. Existing source/task/release validation and accounting unchanged.

threatModel.assets: Owned consent identities, immutable historical records, task binding, diagnostics confidentiality.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Owner API authentication to existing organization journal; sanitized backend code to plain-text UI.
threatModel.abuseCases: Expose foreign consent IDs, display corrupted completion as verified, leak provider response, silently adopt historical authority.
threatModel.mitigations: Filter exact owner/workspace before validation; validate completed legacy receipts; project typed metadata only; no automatic selection, mutation or execution; finite safe errors.

defects.rootCause: New consent UI controls were absent from separately maintained diagnostic method list.
defects.detectionGap: Seeded controller fixtures skipped first real task/consent admission; UI tests covered historical status only.
defects.regression: All nine configuration controls tested with safe denial; private codes/messages suppressed. Actual API-created task through five stages passes clean and stopped-legacy state.
defects.historicalPrevention: One configurationMethods list drives both controls and diagnostics; connected setup no longer pre-seeds consent or task.

defects.rootCause: Owner history omitted consent records created before sequence registration, requiring local receipt ID after lost acknowledgement.
defects.detectionGap: Existing recovery tests assumed sequence already registered.
defects.regression: Owned v1/v2 metadata, foreign filtering, tampered completion, revocation and no authority verified.
defects.historicalPrevention: Existing owner readback exposes discoverable immutable receipt metadata; no new journal or execution endpoint.

rollback: Revert reviewed feature changes if qualification fails; retain original history and denial evidence, never revive consumed approvals.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Unknown codes/raw errors remain hidden; malformed own records counted unverified.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact task/source/release checks unchanged; history is not execution authority.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing CAS unchanged; same first consent remains idempotent and exact-bound.
negativePaths.cancellation: Connected fixture stops consent after run and asserts revoked grants/paidfalse.
negativePaths.api-outage: Unconfirmed delivery never retries automatically; exact intent retained for readback.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Foreign identities filtered before history validation; service actor gets no history.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No accounting policy changes; no paid inference in fixtures.
negativePaths.partial-execution: FinalChief preserves Auditor rejection; successfulworkflow is not proposalacceptance.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing API/controller/journal/UI only; no competing orchestration.
proactiveReview.threats: Readback excludes policy values, credentials, prompts and raw rejected content.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Original live denial unknown; diagnostics and history are factual prerequisite repairs.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: All configuration actions safe/unsafe denial, tamperedlegacy/v2receipt and foreignowner cases.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: QA identified preseeded integration gap; Auditor identified legacycompletion truthfulness and fix verified.
proactiveReview.recovery: Historicalrecords untouched; user can inspect owned consent IDs after lost acknowledgement.
proactiveReview.readiness: 145UIchecks,46affectedchecks and realAPI/CAS clean+legacy five-stage fixtures passed; exact release CI/Redis/security/browser required.
